relationships.subject: Surface P2X4 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Increased surface P2X4 density in the hippocampus of knock-in mice altered LTP and LTD plasticity phenomena at CA1 synapses without affecting basal excitatory transmission.

relationships.subject: Surface P2X4 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results show that increased surface density of neuronal P2X4 contributes to synaptic deficits and alterations in anxiety and memory functions

key_findings: Non-internalized P2X4mCherryIN knock-in mice with increased surface P2X4 show altered CA1 LTP/LTD, anxiolytic effects and spatial memory deficits.
